title: GenAI Is Not A Defense — Civil And Criminal
content: Utah removed "the AI did it" as a defense in both civil and criminal contexts. A principal who uses, prompts, or acts through generative AI remains liable for the resulting statement or act. The criminal rule (§76-2-107, SB 149, effective 2024-05-01) and the civil mirror together eliminate the doctrine across Utah consumer-protection and criminal law. The civil rule was first enacted at §13-2-12(2) (SB 149, effective 2024-05-01) and re-sited at §13-75-102 (SB 226, effective 2025-05-07).
source_citation: Utah SB 149 (2024 General Session), Governor Signed March 13, 2024
